when.en: If you are in danger now, someone is threatening you or holding someone, or people claiming to be officers are at your door demanding money.

name.en: Nigeria Police Force National Cybercrime Centre (NPF-NCCC): e-reporting portal

when.en: To report online fraud, a hacked WhatsApp or social media account, sextortion, fake vendors or investment scams. If money left your account, call your bank first, then report here with screenshots and the account details you paid to.

name.en: Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC): petitions

when.en: To report fraud such as Ponzi and investment schemes, fake visa or job agents, fake promos or people pretending to be EFCC officers. EFCC does not charge money to start or stop an investigation.

Straight away if you shared a PIN, OTP, card or login details, or money left your account. Use the number on the back of your card, the help section inside your banking app, or go to a branch. Ask them to block the card, freeze the account and trace the transfer.

label.en: Call the number on the back of your card or use the help section in your banking app

name.en: Central Bank of Nigeria: Consumer Protection (complaints against banks and fintechs)

when.en: If your bank or payment app has not resolved your fraud complaint, or to check whether a message or grant claiming to be from the CBN is real. The CBN does not give out grants or contracts by SMS, WhatsApp or social media.

For telecom problems your network did not fix, such as a SIM replaced without your consent or a fake network promo. Complain to MTN, Airtel, Glo or 9mobile first and keep the ticket number, then call 622.

label.en: Toll-free, give the ticket number from your network

when.en: Before you invest, check that the platform is registered on the SEC's official website. Report trading or crypto platforms that promise fixed high returns or demand a fee before you can withdraw.

name.en: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (FCCPC)

when.en: To complain about a loan app that harasses you, messages your contacts or shares your photos, or about a seller who took your money.
